PDF pages, covers and text geometry are rendered with PDFium 152.0.7961,
distributed by the bblanchon.PDFium native NuGet packages for Windows, Linux
and macOS. Native PDF JavaScript is not enabled.

The LICENSE and licenses directory are from the matching upstream binary release:
https://github.com/bblanchon/pdfium-binaries/releases/tag/chromium%2F7961

Upstream PDFium source: https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/
Binary packaging source: https://github.com/bblanchon/pdfium-binaries
